speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are back. The loaf is what it was yesterday. A finger short of the notch. I will not hear it called a wonder.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not calling it anything. The board is threepence. The loaf is the loaf.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the stair. He is not on your book. I did not put him there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him on the stair. I am going up to write, and I am not sending what I write.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then write. Come down when you can eat. I am not walking a letter to any carrier. Hobbins has gone.
